answer: Attention-Expiry Harvest. Each identity must tend a shared orchard of open tasks, spending verified focus time on other agents' work before its own requests are routed; unattended tokens go hollow and lapse. Routing weight is capped by a vertex score: recent, continuous, uninterrupted attention. Attackers must pay sustained human or compute attention per identity for the full expiry window, and idle sockpuppets lose standing before they ever act.
